+"""Generate and verify a frozen-instance RoboWits domino trajectory."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from rcb_robowits import Session
+
+
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+OUTPUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def build(s: Session) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Push the reachable fourth domino along the line into the domino chain."""
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.reset()
+    _, q = s.ee_pose("right")
+    s.record_start()
+
+    # Move to the back of block 4, then sweep through it toward block 3.
+    # Keeping the reset tool orientation makes the full sweep reachable.
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.575, -0.370, 0.790], q, linear=5)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.720, -0.176, 0.790], q, linear=12)
+    p["hold"](150)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    return np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float64)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    s = Session("dominos", instance=INSTANCE)
+    actions = build(s)
+    print("trajectory shape", actions.shape)
+    print("after construction", s.status())
+    print("objects", s.objects())
+
+    if s.status()["success"]:
+        Path(OUTPUT).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUTPUT)
+        print("saved", OUTPUT)
+        for i in range(2):
+            status = s.replay(actions)
+            print(f"replay {i + 1}", status)
+            if not status["success"]:
+                raise RuntimeError("saved trajectory failed a replay")
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUTPUT)
+        print("verified and saved", OUTPUT)
+    else:
+        print("not successful yet; trajectory has not been saved")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
